&reftitle.enumsynopsis;
Io\Poll
Event
Read
Data is available for reading. For a listening socket, a connection is ready to be accepted. This event is also reported when the end of the stream is reached, for example when the peer closed a TCP connection.
Write
Data can be written without blocking.
Error
An error occurred on the handle. This event is reported even if it was not requested.
HangUp
The handle was hung up, for example because the other end of a pipe or of a Unix domain socket pair was closed. This event is reported even if it was not requested.
ReadHangUp
The other end closed the connection or shut down its writing half. This event is only reported if it was requested, and only by Io\Poll\Backend::Epoll.
OneShot
A modifier: the watcher is reported once, and then stays silent until its events are set again with Io\Poll\Watcher::modify or Io\Poll\Watcher::modifyEvents.
EdgeTriggered
A modifier: the watcher is reported when its state changes, for example when new data arrives, instead of for as long as the condition holds. It is only supported by the backends for which Io\Poll\Backend::supportsEdgeTriggering returns &true;.
